claim: Domaine Tempier in Le Plan du Castellet is open Monday to Friday 9h-12h and 13h30-17h30 except public holidays; contact +33 4 94 98 70 21.
quote: From monday to friday, 9h-12h and 13h30-17h30 except for public holidays

claim: Tempier is regarded as perhaps Bandol's most recognisable name with reds, rosé and white, and reservation by phone is recommended.
quote: Domaine Tempier is perhaps Bandol's most recognizable name and among its most prestigious

claim: Château de Pibarnon in La Cadière-d'Azur opens its cellar by appointment Monday to Saturday and closes Sunday and public holidays.
quote: Cellar open by appointment only, Monday to Saturday (closed on Sundays and public holidays)

claim: Typical Bandol cellar hours are 9-12 and 14-18, most tastings are complimentary on the expectation of a purchase, and five or six properties per day is realistic.
quote: Typical opening hours are 9 am-midday and 2-6 pm... Many tastings are complimentary; the producers hope that you will make a purchase. In a full day, it's possible to visit up to five or six properties without rushing too much.

claim: Domaine de Terrebrune in Ollioules charges €15 per person for a guided cellar tour and tasting (deductible from purchase), bookable online via terrebrune.fr.
quote: A guided tour of the cellars followed by a tasting costs €15 per person (deductible from purchase) and must be booked by appointment on their website www.terrebrune.fr

claim: Terrebrune opens Monday to Saturday 9:30-12:30 and 14:30-18:00, closed Sundays and named public holidays, and runs 35 hectares of terraced organic vines facing the sea.
quote: Monday to Saturday from 9:30am to 12:30pm and from 14:30pm to 18pm, closed on Sundays

claim: Domaine de la Bégude at Le Camp du Castellet sells experiences from €15 to €89 including 4x4 vineyard tours and picnic lunches, with online booking up to 24 hours before.
quote: The price of Domaine de la Bégude experiences varies between €15.00 and €89.00... you can book for free up to 24 hours before

claim: Clos Sainte Magdeleine works 12 hectares of organic terraces on Cap Canaille's cliffs by the sea, welcoming visitors in its sales cellar Tuesday to Saturday.
quote: Clos Sainte Magdeleine works 12 hectares of vineyards on exceptional terraced sites on the cliffs of Cap Canaille and beside the sea... The team of the domain welcomes you in its cellar of sale, from Tuesday to Saturday

claim: Clos Sainte Magdeleine sits on terraces of France's highest sea cliff at 400 m, with vines 15 to 40 years old yielding mineral whites with herbal and white-peach notes.
quote: steep terraces carved into the sensational Cap Canaille, France's highest sea cliff perched 400 meters over the Mediterranean

claim: The Maison des Vins de Bandol at Le Castellet (Tuesday-Saturday 10-13 / 15-19) hosts six commented domaine tastings per week, with a different vigneron present in person each day in June, July and August.
quote: Each day during June, July and August, a vigneron comes to present his products, offering a privileged opportunity to better understand a domain's life

claim: Château Pradeaux in Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer (Portalis family since 1752) opens Monday-Friday 9-12:30 and 15-18, plus Saturday by appointment.
quote: open Monday to Friday from 9am to 12:30pm and from 3pm to 6pm, and Saturday by appointment

claim: Alain Pascal welcomes visitors year-round at Domaine du Gros'Noré (17 ha on La Cadière d'Azur hillsides), with booking strongly recommended.
quote: booking a tasting at Domaine du Gros'Nore is highly recommended

claim: Château Sainte Anne at Sainte-Anne-d'Évenos is a 15-hectare family estate farmed organically with low-intervention reds, and keeps old vintages on offer for tasting at the domaine.
quote: It is rare to find several very old vintages still available for tasting at the domaine

claim: Domaine du Bagnol in Cassis is a 7-hectare property run by Jean-Louis and Sébastien Genovesi, fully organic since 2014, offering 45-minute tours twice daily in summer (advance booking required).
quote: Sébastien Genovesi has maneuvered the winery toward fully organic practices since 2014

claim: Domaine du Paternel in Cassis (Santini family, three generations, organic) accepts walk-in tastings without reservation and now runs partnered Le Nez du Vin sensory workshops.
quote: Reservations are not required for tastings at the venue. Visitors can arrive without an appointment

claim: Château Romassan in Le Castellet, acquired by the Ott family in 1956, runs a Mourvèdre-led estate with a cellar modernised in 2023 and offers exclusive tastings of rosé, white and red across its three Provence boutiques.
quote: modernised in 2023 to allow for increasingly precise winemaking

claim: Combined Cassis-Bandol-Le Castellet wine tours run as small-group day-trips covering cliff calanques and vineyards with pickup from regional bases, suitable for guests staying around Le Castellet.
quote: Cassis, Bandol, Le Castellet wine tour: Cliffs and Vineyards

claim: Grape Escapes operates an Exclusive Bandol and Cassis private wine tour package combining both AOCs with hotel pickup, aimed at higher-end visitors.
quote: Exclusive Bandol and Cassis Wine Tour | Grape Escapes
